request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Coin-Eyed Duelist".

Creative brief
Name: Coin-Eyed Duelist
Collection: Ironroad Marauders. Organized highway raiders who turn practical medieval weapons, shields, traps, chains, and stolen supplies into disciplined projectile patterns.
Core concept: A flamboyant ricochet attacker that uses stolen coins as spinning projectiles.
Body and silhouette: Lean swordsman with a featherless wide hat, short cape, narrow rapier, and upright stance.
Signature features: Coin-covered eye patch, coin-chain belt, and bright metal glove.
Palette and materials: Burgundy, dark leather, tarnished gold, and silver-gray steel.
Movement personality: Proud, theatrical, and deceptively quick.
Attack concept: Flicks two large coins diagonally; each changes direction once at a visible sparkle point.
Directional details: The coin eye patch always covers the right eye.
Avoid: Noble hero, pirate stereotype, tiny realistic coins.
